stem.en: Kabir says "a cell could just make more NAD+ when it runs out". Why does that not solve it?

text.en: More buckets only delays the jam. Every bucket fills and stays full unless something takes the electrons off. The problem is emptying, not the number.

feedback.en: A thousand buckets jam after five hundred glucoses instead of five. Nothing has changed.
Cells make it from a vitamin, slowly. Making more would still not empty any.

text.en: The buckets are too heavy to make more.

feedback.en: Size is not the issue. Full buckets are.

explanation.en: A carrier problem is a flow problem. Count what fills and what empties. If nothing empties, the size of the fleet does not matter.
